sections.content:
**Executive Summary – Mandi District (Multi‑Hazard Report)**  
The monitoring system has identified a single active alert across the districts under observation, which includes Mandi. This alert indicates that at least one weather‑related or other natural hazard condition is currently in effect for the area. Stakeholders should remain vigilant, follow official guidance, and be prepared to implement any recommended safety measures until the alert is lifted.
